description: Shared Renovate settings for the repos that build software rather than infrastructure. The IaC fleet uses github>coursekata/ck-tf-modules//renovate/default.json instead: it runs Renovate as a workflow on GITHUB_TOKEN so bot pull requests do not auto-run a terraform plan holding cloud credentials. Nothing here plans against a cloud, so these repos run the hosted Renovate App, whose pull requests trigger CI normally — which is the whole point of proposing a dependency change.

major.description: Majors wait for a human on the dependency dashboard.

packageRules.description: One pull request for the ordinary updates. These repos gate on a full build, and for an image that is tens of minutes of matrix; batching means one run covers the batch rather than one per dependency. Majors are excluded and stay individually reviewable.

Pre-1.0 minors can break and Renovate still classes them minor, so the major gate above misses them. Ungrouped deliberately: bundled into the batch, one 0.x dependency would hold the whole group behind an approval.
